title: Orbital Station Essentials
summary: Workflow simulation: create a cohesive pack of sixteen static space-station props, then exercise ORION's normal approval, generation, live Discord progress, packaging, creative review, and marketplace-setup handoff.
rationale: This is an operator-requested workflow test, not an autonomous market conclusion.
Sixteen visually distinct station props test whether ORION can sustain a coherent palette, perspective, scale language, and transparent export contract across a larger pack.
The first candidate intentionally validates static base-sprite production; animation and interactive-state upgrades remain a separately reviewed versioned enhancement.

generation.perspective: consistent slightly elevated three-quarter game-prop view with readable front faces
generation.outline: Use a crisp one-to-two-pixel dark navy outline with clean, readable industrial silhouettes
generation.lighting: Soft upper-left neutral station lighting with restrained cyan, teal, amber, or warning-red emissive indicators

assets.name: Holographic Navigation Table
assets.description: A futuristic circular command table projecting a compact glowing three-dimensional star map
prompt_notes: Show one sturdy round table and one contained holographic star-map projection
No crew, chairs, room, readable text, or loose interface panels

assets.name: Alien Specimen Containment Tank
assets.description: A reinforced glass cylinder filled with luminous teal liquid and one original small alien organism
prompt_notes: Keep the organism abstract and non-humanoid with no franchise resemblance
Show readable glass, metal braces, base controls, and contained bubbles

assets.name: Anti-Gravity Cargo Platform
assets.description: A low hovering industrial platform for moving heavy station equipment
prompt_notes: Show one empty platform with lift emitters and subtle downward glow
No cargo, operator, floor, or cast shadow

assets.name: Quantum Communication Terminal
assets.description: A tall secured communication console with several integrated floating holographic screens
prompt_notes: Keep holograms attached visually to the one terminal
Use abstract diagrams only with no readable text or logos

assets.name: Futuristic Vending Machine
assets.description: A compact automated station vending machine dispensing sealed space snacks and drinks
prompt_notes: Show small product silhouettes behind glass and a simple illuminated control area
No brands, readable labels, person, or scenery

assets.name: Emergency Spacesuit Locker
assets.description: A freestanding emergency locker with its front open enough to reveal one astronaut suit and helmet
prompt_notes: The suit remains stored inside the cabinet and is not a character
Use an original utilitarian suit design with no agency or franchise marks

assets.name: Plasma Battery Unit
assets.description: A portable armored energy container built around a bright cyan plasma cell
prompt_notes: Readable carry handles, protected core, and charge indicators
Exactly one battery with no weapon, cable, or scenery

assets.name: Space Station Coffee Machine
assets.description: A compact automated coffee dispenser designed for a crew galley in microgravity
prompt_notes: Include a secured cup cradle, dispensing nozzle, and illuminated buttons
No loose liquid, brand, readable text, counter, or room

assets.name: Holographic Security Scanner
assets.description: A walk-through station security arch projecting contained horizontal scanning beams
prompt_notes: Show one empty scanner arch with a readable pass-through opening
No person, floor, wall, text, or detached equipment

assets.name: Robotic Cleaning Station
assets.description: A compact docking station housing one small autonomous floor-cleaning robot
prompt_notes: The dock and robot form one coherent asset with the robot visibly seated
Friendly functional design without a face, logo, floor, or scenery

assets.name: Zero-Gravity Sleeping Bunk
assets.description: A compact enclosed crew sleeping bunk with safety restraints and integrated personal storage
prompt_notes: Show the bunk as one modular station furniture unit
No person, bedding clutter, wall, room, readable text, or logo

assets.name: Futuristic Weapon Rack
assets.description: A secured metallic station rack holding several compact original science-fiction laser tools
prompt_notes: Keep every item visibly locked into one rack
No copied weapon designs, loose weapons, person, wall, readable text, or scenery

assets.name: Space Station Aquarium
assets.description: A reinforced transparent habitat tank containing small bioluminescent alien aquatic life
prompt_notes: Show one self-contained tank with a sturdy base and restrained internal plants
Use original abstract aquatic creatures with no room, stand, or readable labels

assets.name: Asteroid Sample Analyzer
assets.description: A laboratory analysis machine suspending one mineral sample beneath a compact holographic scan
prompt_notes: Keep the sample, scanner, and hologram within one machine silhouette
Abstract graphs only with no readable text, scientist, desk, or scenery

assets.name: Atmospheric Control Unit
assets.description: A vertical station life-support machine with vents, exposed service pipes, and air-quality indicators
prompt_notes: Present as a self-contained equipment module rather than part of a wall
No readable metrics, room, floor, logo, smoke, or character

assets.name: Teleportation Pad
assets.description: A circular station teleportation platform with integrated control panels and contained concentric energy rings
prompt_notes: Show one empty pad and restrained active energy above it
No person, portal destination, room, floor, text, or extra machinery

notes: Workflow simulation; human creative approval is required before marketplace setup.
Initial generation produces static base sprites. Interactive states and animations require a later separately reviewed versioned enhancement.
